release_name: v0.11.3 - Download Queue & Cookie Status Fixes
features: 🐛 Fixed: Download queue processing - videos no longer stuck in 'queued' status
🐛 Fixed: Cookie status now checks database instead of only filesystem
🐛 Fixed: YouTube API errors now properly reported in artist discovery
🔧 Enhanced: Retry/stop download endpoints now fully functional
bug_fixes: Download queue: process_pending_downloads() now actually processes queued downloads
Cookie status: get_cookie_status() checks both file and database
Artist discovery: YouTube API errors now visible in response stats
Retry download: Added missing retry_download() method to adapter
Stop download: Enhanced cancel_download() to check database
inherited_from_v0_11_2: 🆕 PO token provider for YouTube bot detection bypass
🐛 Fixed: Cookie upload supports large files (16MB)
inherited_from_v0_11_0: 🎛️ Web UI Management: Configure schedules via Settings
known_issues: #180: Themes not automatically listed (requires database seeding)
upgrade_notes: 🔄 Download queue will auto-process on next Celery beat cycle
🍪 Cookie status now consistent across all pages
